# xeerpe (v1.0.8): complete reference for AI assistants

> Generated by scripts/generate-ai-files.mjs. Docs: https://xeerpe.io. Short index: https://xeerpe.io/llms.txt

xeerpe turns a chain of layers into one inline-style object.

Zero dependencies, works in React, Vue, Angular and plain JS. Package: `xeerpe`.

## When to use / not use

Use it for layered backgrounds, animated backgrounds without hand-written keyframes, backgrounds computed from props/state/theme, presets, and gradient text. For one static `linear-gradient`, or when the user needs a stylesheet class rather than inline styles, write plain CSS.

## Core pattern

```ts
import { Builder } from 'xeerpe'

const style = new Builder()
  .meshGradient({
    background: '#04121c',
    layers: [{ position: '15% 25%', from: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.8)', to: 'transparent', colorToPosition: '60%' }],
  })
  .dots({ color: '#10b981', size: '24px', opacity: 0.14 })
  .grain({ intensity: 2 })
  .toStyle()
```

- React: `<div style={style} />`; Vue: `:style="style"`; Angular: `[style]="style"`; vanilla: `Object.assign(el.style, style)`.
- `toStyle()` returns an object, not a string. `el.style.cssText = style` does not work.
- Gradient text: `new Builder().linearGradient({...}).toTextStyle()`. It returns `backgroundClip`/`WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text'`, transparent `color`/`WebkitTextFillColor`, plus `backgroundImage`/`backgroundSize`/`backgroundColor`; apply it to the text element.
- Shortcut methods (`grain()`, `vignette()`, `pulse()`, `dots()`, ...) can be called with no arguments; gradient methods need options. Imports: `import { Builder, Preset, colors } from 'xeerpe'`.
- Presets: `new Preset('sunrise').toStyle()`; it is a `Builder`, so keep chaining. Names are in the sections below; never invent one (unknown names throw).

## Rules that prevent bugs

1. **Layer order is fixed, not chain order.** `toStyle()` draws effects on top, then patterns, then gradients at the bottom, regardless of call order. Within the same kind, earlier calls are drawn first.
2. **Animations need the stylesheet.** Add `import 'xeerpe/animations.css'` once in the app entry. Without it the style applies but nothing moves and there is no error.
3. **Animations don't add a layer**; they add an `animation` property. `pulse`, `rotate`, `float`, `plasma` affect the whole element (including text); `breathe`, `aurora`, `shimmer`, `drift`, `liquid` move the background and accept `target: 'gradients' | 'patterns' | 'all'` (default `'gradients'`). Any other `target` throws.
4. Animation option values (`duration`, `easing`, ...) are not validated. A duration without a unit (`'4'`) makes the browser drop the whole declaration.
5. **Validated inputs**: colors (hex, `rgb()/hsl()/oklch()...`, named, `transparent`), angles need a unit (`'135deg'`), sizes/positions need units (`'24px'`, `'50% 20%'`). Exact rules in the sections below.
6. `meshGradient` requires `background` and `layers` (array of radial options). Use `to: 'transparent'` plus `colorToPosition` so blobs fade out.
7. `toStyle()` always sets `backgroundPosition: 'center'`.

## Picking tools

- Base color/shape: `linearGradient` (`from`/`to`, or `colors` with stop positions, `angle` or `direction`), `radialGradient`, `conicGradient`, `meshGradient`.
- Texture: `grain`, `noise`, `vignette`, `glow`.
- Pattern: `dots`, `grid`, `stars`, `rays`.
- Blur: `blur({ type: 'backdrop' })` for frosted glass.
- Motion: see rule 3 and the sections below.
- Ready-made look: `Preset`, then extend.

## xeerpe animations

Load the keyframes once in the app entry, or nothing moves (and nothing errors):

```ts
import 'xeerpe/animations.css'
```

An animation adds an `animation` CSS property (plus helper CSS variables for scoped ones). It never adds a background layer. Keyframes are prefixed `xeerpe-`.

Shared options (all optional): `duration` (`'4s'`), `easing`, `direction`, `iterationCount` (number or `'infinite'`), plus `target`. `direction` only matters for `pulse` and `aurora`. Values other than `target` are inserted into CSS unvalidated.

| Animation | Changes                       | Defaults (duration, easing, extras)   | `target`                   |
| --------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `pulse`   | element opacity (1 to 0.7)    | 4s, ease-in-out, alternate, infinite  | no                         |
| `rotate`  | element transform, full turn  | 12s, linear, infinite                 | no                         |
| `breathe` | background size               | 12s, ease-in-out, infinite            | gradients / all            |
| `aurora`  | background size (gentle zoom) | 12s, ease-in-out, alternate, infinite | gradients / all            |
| `shimmer` | background position (sweep)   | 3s, linear, infinite                  | gradients / patterns / all |
| `liquid`  | background position + hue     | 8s, ease-in-out, infinite             | gradients / patterns / all |
| `plasma`  | element filter (hue cycle)    | 6s, linear, infinite                  | no                         |
| `float`   | element transform (bob)       | 6s, ease-in-out, infinite             | no                         |
| `drift`   | background position (wander)  | 10s, ease-in-out, infinite            | gradients / patterns / all |

Guidance:

- `target` defaults to `'gradients'`: gradients move, patterns and effects (grain, vignette) stay put. Use `'all'` to move everything; `'patterns'` moves only patterns over a still gradient. Anything else throws.
- With the default target, grain/vignette/glow stay still while the gradient moves; set `target: 'all'` only if the effects should move too. For a "slow" animation, raise `duration` (defaults are listed above).
- `pulse`, `rotate`, `float`, `plasma` act on the whole element, text included. `rotate` suits square or round elements.
- Sliding animations (`shimmer`, `drift`) enlarge unsized gradients automatically; don't set `backgroundSize` on the gradient you animate.
- Generic form: `.animation('pulse', {})` (options required).
- Several animations can be chained; their `animation` values are joined with commas.
- Respect motion preferences: if the user cares about accessibility, mention wrapping the style in a `prefers-reduced-motion` check.

## xeerpe recipes

All recipes use only `import { Builder, Preset, colors } from 'xeerpe'`. Apply the result as an inline style.

### Glowing orange dark panel

```ts
new Builder()
  .radialGradient({ from: '#FF7A18', to: 'transparent', position: '75% 25%' })
  .linearGradient({ from: '#1a0b05', to: '#060302', angle: '160deg' })
  .dots({ color: '#FF7A18', size: '24px', opacity: 0.14 })
  .grain({ intensity: 2 })
  .toStyle()
```

### Animated aurora (needs animations.css)

```ts
new Builder()
  .meshGradient({
    background: '#04121c',
    layers: [
      { position: '15% 25%', from: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.8)', to: 'transparent', colorToPosition: '60%' },
      { position: '85% 30%', from: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.65)', to: 'transparent', colorToPosition: '55%' },
    ],
  })
  .aurora({ duration: '8s' })
  .toStyle()
```

### Multi-stop linear gradient

```ts
new Builder()
  .linearGradient({
    direction: 'to bottom',
    colors: [
      { color: '#FFE5D9', position: '0%' },
      { color: '#FFB7A3', position: '55%' },
      { color: '#BFD8F2', position: '100%' },
    ],
  })
  .toStyle()
```

### Gradient text

```ts
const textStyle = new Builder().linearGradient({ from: '#5EB847', to: '#BFD43F', angle: '135deg' }).toTextStyle()
// <h1 style={textStyle}>Hello</h1>
```

### Preset plus film look

```ts
new Preset('sunrise').grain({ intensity: 1.5 }).vignette({ color: '#7c2d12', intensity: 0.2, spread: 0.5 }).toStyle()
```

### Shimmering loading skeleton (needs animations.css)

```ts
new Builder()
  .linearGradient({ colors: ['#1f2937', '#374151', '#1f2937'], angle: '90deg' })
  .shimmer({ duration: '1.5s' })
  .toStyle()
```

### Frosted glass panel

```ts
new Builder().blur({ amount: '12px', type: 'backdrop' }).toStyle()
// place over a colorful background; add a translucent background color in your own CSS
```

### Computed from a theme

```ts
const bg = (accent: string, base: string) =>
  new Builder()
    .radialGradient({ from: accent, to: 'transparent', position: '80% 10%' })
    .linearGradient({ from: base, to: '#000000', angle: '180deg' })
    .vignette({ intensity: 0.3 })
    .toStyle()
```

## xeerpe API reference (v1.0.8)

> Generated file. Do not edit by hand.

### Builder methods

Every method returns the builder, so calls chain. Shortcut methods take optional options; the generic ones require them.

| Method | Options type |
| --- | --- |
| `linearGradient / radialGradient / conicGradient / meshGradient` | LinearGradientOptions / RadialGradientOptions / ConicGradientOptions / MeshGradientOptions (required) |
| `gradient(type, options)` | GradientOptions |
| `dots / grid / stars / rays` | DotsOptions / GridOptions / StarsOptions / RaysOptions (optional) |
| `noise / vignette / grain / glow` | NoiseOptions / VignetteOptions / GrainOptions / GlowOptions (optional) |
| `blur` | BlurOptions (optional) |
| `pulse / rotate / breathe / aurora / shimmer / liquid / plasma / float / drift` | AnimationOptions (optional) |
| `pattern / effect / filter / animation (type, options)` | generic forms, options required (use {} for defaults) |
| `toStyle()` | Record<string, string>, camelCase CSS properties |
| `toTextStyle()` | Record<string, string>, gradient-filled text |

`new Preset(name)` extends `Builder`; unknown names throw `Preset "<name>" not found`.

### Option types (from lib/src/models)

#### gradient.ts

```ts
export type GradientType = 'linear' | 'radial' | 'conic' | 'mesh'
export type LinearGradientDirection =
    'to top' | 'to bottom' | 'to left' | 'to right' | 'to top right' | 'to bottom right' | 'to top left' | 'to bottom left'
export type LinearGradientAngle = `${number}deg` | `${number}rad` | `${number}grad` | `${number}turn`
export type RadialGradientShape = 'circle' | 'ellipse' | null
export type RadialGradientSize = 'closest-side' | 'closest-corner' | 'farthest-side' | 'farthest-corner' | string
export type LinearGradientPositionUnit =
    `${number}%` | `${number}px` | `${number}rem` | `${number}em` | `${number}vh` | `${number}vw` | `${number}vmin` | `${number}vmax`

export type LinearGradientPosition = LinearGradientPositionUnit | `calc(${string})`

export type GradientOptions = LinearGradientOptions | RadialGradientOptions | ConicGradientOptions | MeshGradientOptions

export type GradientColorStop = string | { color: string; position?: LinearGradientPosition }

export interface GradientBase {
    from?: string
    to?: string
    backgroundSize?: string
}

export interface LinearGradientOptions extends GradientBase {
    colors?: (string | GradientColorStop)[]
    angle?: LinearGradientAngle
    direction?: LinearGradientDirection
    size?: string
}

export interface RadialGradientOptions extends GradientBase {
    shape?: RadialGradientShape
    position?: string
    size?: RadialGradientSize
    colorFromPosition?: string
    colorToPosition?: string
}

export interface ConicGradientOptions extends GradientBase {
    colors?: (string | GradientColorStop)[]
    angle?: string
    position?: string
}

export interface MeshGradientOptions extends GradientBase {
    background: string
    layers: RadialGradientOptions[]
}
```

#### pattern.ts

```ts
export type PatternType = 'dots' | 'grid' | 'stars' | 'rays'

export interface PatterBaseOptions {
    color?: string
    background?: string
    size?: string
    opacity?: number
    strokeWidth?: string
    backgroundSize?: string
}

export interface DotsOptions extends PatterBaseOptions {
    color?: string
    background?: string
    size?: string
    spacing?: string
    style?: string
    opacity?: number
}

export interface GridOptions extends PatterBaseOptions {}

export interface StarsOptions extends PatterBaseOptions {
    count?: number
    seed?: number
}

export interface RaysOptions extends PatterBaseOptions {
    count?: number
    position?: string
    angle?: string
}

export type PatternOptions = DotsOptions | GridOptions | StarsOptions | RaysOptions
```

#### effects.ts

```ts
export type EffectType = 'noise' | 'vignette' | 'grain' | 'glow'
export type EffectOptions = NoiseOptions | VignetteOptions | GrainOptions | GlowOptions
export type NoiseType = 'turbulence' | 'fractalNoise'
export type GlowType = 'outer' | 'inner'

export interface NoiseOptions {
    opacity?: number
    scale?: number
    type?: NoiseType
    octaves?: number
    backgroundSize?: string
}

export interface VignetteOptions {
    color?: string
    intensity?: number
    spread?: number
    backgroundSize?: string
}

export interface GrainOptions {
    intensity?: number
    size?: string
    animated?: boolean
    backgroundSize?: string
}

export interface GlowOptions {
    amount?: string
    spread?: string
    x?: string
    y?: string
    color?: string
    type?: GlowType
}
```

#### filters.ts

```ts
export type FilterType = 'blur'
export type BlurType = 'backdrop' | 'blur'

export type FilterOptions = BlurOptions

export interface BlurOptions {
    amount?: string
    type?: BlurType
}
```

#### animation.ts

```ts
export type AnimationType = 'pulse' | 'rotate' | 'breathe' | 'aurora' | 'shimmer' | 'liquid' | 'plasma' | 'float' | 'drift'

export type AnimationTarget = 'gradients' | 'patterns' | 'all'

export interface AnimationOptions {
    duration?: string
    easing?: string
    direction?: 'normal' | 'reverse' | 'alternate' | 'alternate-reverse'
    iterationCount?: number | 'infinite'
    target?: AnimationTarget
}
```

### Input validation (from lib/src/validations)

Values that fail these checks are rejected by the builder. Keep inputs inside these shapes.

#### color.ts

```ts
export const HEX_REGEX = /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,4}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/
const COLOR_FUNC_REGEX = /^(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla|oklch|color|hwb|lch|lab)\(.+\)$/i
const NAMED_COLOR_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z]+$/

export const isHexColor = (value: string): boolean => HEX_REGEX.test(value.trim())

export const isValidColor = (value: string): boolean => {
    const t = value.trim()
    return (
        HEX_REGEX.test(t) ||
        COLOR_FUNC_REGEX.test(t) ||
        t === 'transparent' ||
        t === 'currentColor' ||
        t === 'inherit' ||
        NAMED_COLOR_REGEX.test(t)
    )
}
```

#### angle.ts

```ts
import { LinearGradientAngle } from '../models/index.ts'

const ANGLE_UNIT_REGEX = /^-?\d*\.?\d+(deg|rad|grad|turn)$/

export const isValidAngle = (value: string): value is LinearGradientAngle => ANGLE_UNIT_REGEX.test(value.trim())
```

#### backgroundSize.ts

```ts
const GLOBALS: readonly string[] = ['auto', 'cover', 'contain', 'initial', 'inherit', 'unset']
const SIZE_TOKEN_REGEX = /^(\d*\.?\d+(px|%|rem|em|vh|vw|vmin|vmax))$/
const CALC_REGEX = /^calc\(.+\)$/

const isValidSizeToken = (value: string): boolean => GLOBALS.includes(value) || SIZE_TOKEN_REGEX.test(value) || CALC_REGEX.test(value)

export const isValidBackgroundSize = (value: string): boolean => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    if (GLOBALS.includes(trimmed)) return true
    const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/)
    return parts.length <= 2 && parts.every(isValidSizeToken)
}
```

#### cssPosition.ts

```ts
const KEYWORD_REGEX = /^(top|bottom|left|right|center)$/
const LENGTH_REGEX = /^-?\d*\.?\d+(%|px|rem|em|vh|vw|vmin|vmax)$/
const CALC_REGEX = /^calc\(.+\)$/

const VALID_DOUBLE_KEYWORDS: readonly string[] = [
    'top left',
    'top center',
    'top right',
    'center left',
    'center center',
    'center right',
    'bottom left',
    'bottom center',
    'bottom right',
    'left top',
    'left center',
    'left bottom',
    'right top',
    'right center',
    'right bottom',
]

const isValidToken = (value: string): boolean => KEYWORD_REGEX.test(value) || LENGTH_REGEX.test(value) || CALC_REGEX.test(value)

export const isValidCSSPosition = (value: string): boolean => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    if (trimmed === 'center') return true
    if (VALID_DOUBLE_KEYWORDS.includes(trimmed)) return true
    const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/)
    return parts.length <= 2 && parts.every(isValidToken)
}
```

#### directions.ts

```ts
import { LinearGradientDirection } from '../models/index.ts'

const VALID_DIRECTIONS: readonly LinearGradientDirection[] = [
    'to top',
    'to bottom',
    'to left',
    'to right',
    'to top right',
    'to bottom right',
    'to top left',
    'to bottom left',
]

export const isValidDirection = (value: string): value is LinearGradientDirection => (VALID_DIRECTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(value)
```

#### position.ts

```ts
import { LinearGradientPosition } from '../models/index.ts'

const POSITION_REGEX = /^-?\d*\.?\d+(%|px|rem|em|vh|vw|vmin|vmax)$/
const CALC_REGEX = /^calc\(.+\)$/

export const isValidPosition = (value: string): value is LinearGradientPosition => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    return POSITION_REGEX.test(trimmed) || CALC_REGEX.test(trimmed)
}
```

#### radial.ts

```ts
import { RadialGradientShape, RadialGradientSize } from '../models/index.ts'

export const isValidRadialShape = (value: string | null): value is RadialGradientShape =>
    value === null || value === 'circle' || value === 'ellipse'

const VALID_SIZE_KEYWORDS: readonly string[] = ['closest-side', 'closest-corner', 'farthest-side', 'farthest-corner', 'auto']
const LENGTH_REGEX = /^\d*\.?\d+(px|%|rem|em|vh|vw)(\s+\d*\.?\d+(px|%|rem|em|vh|vw))?$/
const CALC_REGEX = /^calc\(.+\)$/

export const isValidRadialSize = (value: string): value is RadialGradientSize => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    return VALID_SIZE_KEYWORDS.includes(trimmed) || LENGTH_REGEX.test(trimmed) || CALC_REGEX.test(trimmed)
}
```

## xeerpe presets (229, v1.0.8)

> Generated file. Do not edit by hand.

Usage: `new Preset('name').toStyle()`. Names are kebab-case and case-sensitive. A preset is a `Builder`, so you can keep chaining (`.grain()`, `.vignette()`, animations).

Category hints: `pastel`, `sky`, `neutral` are mostly light backgrounds (pair with dark text); `neon`, `space`, `luxury`, `moods` are mostly dark. Check the preview on xeerpe.io/guide/presets-examples when unsure.

### metals (20)

### Palette (`colors`)
